physical_problem: 3D periodic wall-resolved channel flow at Re_tau=180, body-force driven, compared against Moser-Kim-Mansour (1999) DNS

observable.primary: u+ profile RMS error vs DNS in y+ ∈ [30, 100]
secondary: Reynolds stress -u'v'+ RMS error vs DNS

grid_levels.expected: DNS-matched domain (Lx/h≈12.6, Lz/h≈4.2) + extended statistics (≥4 eddy turnovers)

decision_criteria.promote: ≥2 grid levels with u+ RMS error ≤3% AND monotone convergence
decision_criteria.terminal: no transition (Reynolds stress ≈0) OR error >3% non-monotone OR instability
decision_criteria.honest_fail: monotone convergence but best RMS > 3% — document error budget (discretization vs statistics)

fix_description.domain_length: L4: Lx/h=12.77 (was 8.26 in L3), matching DNS 12.6
fix_description.statistics_window: L4: 80000 avg steps → ~4.0 eddy turnovers (was 30000 → 1.45 in L3)
fix_description.u_tau_measurement: force balance instead of wall-shear gradient
